instruction: Cinematic medium close-up still of a couple at sunset by the water. On the right, the blonde woman in the patterned halter top (R1) holds her wine glass and looks back at him with a soft smile. They stand close together, facing one another in an intimate moment. Warm golden hour light illuminates them from behind, creating a soft lens flare and a warm, romantic atmosphere.
